title: ctdGAN
summary: ctdGAN is a Conditional GAN for tabular data synthesis designed to alleviate class imbalance, using a space-partitioning and cluster-aware conditional sampling mechanism. Its data transformer module imports ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder directly from rdt to preprocess tabular columns before GAN training, so RDT's reversible transforms are embedded as a core building block of the model.
